issues.explanation: docs/api/totem.md keeps the old Status: proposal banner alongside the new Status: implemented lines, leaving a contradictory contract header.
Pairing command generates a random 6-digit code without checking global uniqueness despite the unique DB constraint, so a rare collision would raise a 500 instead of retrying.
Ticket priority check uses is_numeric then (int) cast, so a float like 10.5 is coerced to 10 and accepted instead of rejected as invalid_priority.
TotemJwt::decode only rejects expired tokens when exp is present, so a correctly signed token without exp would never expire (low impact since forging requires the secret).
config/services.php adds totem.web_origin but config/cors.php reads TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN directly from env, leaving one redundant config key.

conventions.evidence: Reuses IssueTicket (TotemQueueController.php:340), Log::channel('audit') without codes (TotemPairingCode.php:71, TotemAuthController.php:160,167), reversible migrations, docs + CHANGELOG updated; nits: stale proposal banner retained, unused services.totem.web_origin

readability.evidence: Small focused methods resolveEntity/resolveQueue, clear names, docblocks on TotemJwt/TotemAuth/migrations, consistent sibling style, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: routes/api.php:1-15 four routes with throttle 10/30; TotemAuthController.php:104-181 format 400, locked txn, consumed+totem+JWT+entity 200, uniform 401; TotemAuth.php:385-437 invalid_token + intersection scope; TotemQueueController.php:246-351 queues/priorities/issue per spec; TotemPriorities 0/10/20; minus stale proposal banner and rare code-collision edge

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the totem BFF (routes, middleware, controllers, models, factories, migrations, config, docs, tests); no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: TotemAuth.php:387-425 uniform 401 for missing/invalid/expired/inactive/mismatch; TotemAuthController.php:112-127 no oracle + audit never logs code; TotemJwt.php:632-640 enforces alg HS256 + hash_equals; bootstrap/app.php:771-777 api 429 rate_limited; config/cors.php:789-826 localhost patterns only, supports_credentials false

simplicity.evidence: Minimal correct HS256 without new dependency (TotemJwt.php:591-670), backend-owned TotemPriorities single source, Eloquent reads, no service/repository layers or duplication

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TotemApiTest.php:1503-1815 covers artisan success/fail, 400/401 variants, single-use, 10/min throttle, expired/tampered/wrong-secret tokens, totem/preset deactivation, ordering/scope revocation, 403/404 queue resolution, inactive/invalid-priority paths, sequential A001/A002 channel totem, CORS preflight

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF: pairing command plus code exchange, HS256 JWT auth middleware with intersected queue scope, scoped queues/priorities/ticket endpoints reusing IssueTicket, CORS, throttling, migrations, config, docs and thorough Pest tests. Approve with nits for the contradictory proposal banner, rare pairing-code collision, float priority coercion, missing-exp acceptance, and one redundant config key.
